svg.text: Each arrow points from a unit to a unit it uses (its uses clause). Units higher up depend on units lower down; nothing points upwards, so there are no cycles.

Generated from the source on 2026-10-28 (66 units, 208 uses). Light arrows go to the shared basics (uTypes, uCommands, uStopwatch, uIOGate, uMemoryGuard); dashed = used in the implementation section only.
fast TIFF: raw rows, own LZW
find / start TC, side by side
since 1.2: 3D models (STL) with sections drawn by the graphics card, combining animated GIFs.
L0 … L7: dependency depth (L0 uses no other VersariteViewer unit). Dashed box: retired unit, still compiled. Versarite Image Lab adds its own units on top of these, in source\microscopy\ (not shown).
